_doc: Perfis de stack usados pelo scaffold.py. github_setup = steps YAML (sem indentacao base). build = comando de preparo (sem rodar testes). Para stacks fora da lista use 'generic' e edite o workflow.

java-maven.label: Java + Maven
java-maven.github_setup:
- name: Set up Java 21
  uses: actions/setup-java@v4
  with:
    distribution: temurin
    java-version: '21'
    cache: maven

java-gradle.label: Java/Kotlin + Gradle
java-gradle.github_setup:
- name: Set up Java 21
  uses: actions/setup-java@v4
  with:
    distribution: temurin
    java-version: '21'
    cache: gradle

node.label: JavaScript/TypeScript + Node.js
node.github_setup:
- name: Set up Node.js
  uses: actions/setup-node@v4
  with:
    node-version: '22'
node.build: if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi

python.label: Python
python.github_setup:
- name: Set up Python
  uses: actions/setup-python@v5
  with:
    python-version: '3.12'
python.build: python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade pip; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt; fi; if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then python3 -m pip install -q -e '.[test]' 2>/dev/null || python3 -m pip install -q -e .; fi

dotnet.label: C# + .NET
dotnet.github_setup:
- name: Set up .NET
  uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
  with:
    dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

go.label: Go
go.github_setup:
- name: Set up Go
  uses: actions/setup-go@v5
  with:
    go-version: 'stable'

rust.label: Rust
rust.github_setup:
- name: Set up Rust
  uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

php.label: PHP
php.github_setup:
- name: Set up PHP
  uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
  with:
    php-version: '8.3'
    tools: composer

ruby.label: Ruby
ruby.github_setup:
- name: Set up Ruby
  uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
  with:
    ruby-version: '3.3'
    bundler-cache: true

c-cpp.label: C/C++
c-cpp.build: if [ -f CMakeLists.txt ]; then cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build; elif [ -f Makefile ]; then make; fi
